parameters.content:
## SEO Spider That Thinks

### How it works

This workflow receives an SEO crawl request via webhook or manual test trigger, parses the request, applies crawl configuration, and iterates through a URL queue until the crawl is complete or a limit is reached. For each page, it waits according to the crawl delay, fetches the HTML, parses SEO-relevant page data, updates the crawl queue, and sends the page findings to multiple Claude-based specialist agents. The agent outputs are merged into a synthesized SEO diagnosis per page, then the workflow loops back for the next URL before building and returning a final SEO report.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL and expected request payload for the starting URL, crawl limits, and any crawl options used by the parse request code.
- Add Anthropic API credentials or headers for each Claude HTTP Request node, including the API key, model, version header, and message payload format.
- Review the Set - Config node values for crawl delay, thin content threshold, title length limit, and meta description length limit.
- Ensure the custom Code nodes are configured for your site rules, queue structure, HTML parsing expectations, and final report format.
- Use the Manual Trigger node for test runs before enabling the webhook in production.

### Customization

Adjust crawl limits, delay, SEO thresholds, Claude prompts, and the specialist agent mix to match the depth of audit required. The workflow can also be extended to store reports in a database, send alerts, or export results to a document or spreadsheet.

## Receive crawl request

Entry cluster that starts the workflow from either a webhook or manual trigger, parses the incoming crawl request, and applies the base crawl configuration.

## Control crawl queue

Selects the next URL to crawl and decides whether the crawl should continue or branch to final report generation when the queue is empty or limits are reached.

## Fetch and parse page

Applies the crawl delay, fetches the current page HTML, extracts page data, and updates the crawl queue with discovered URLs before analysis begins.

## Core SEO agents

Runs the upper Claude agent cluster for technical SEO, search intent, and entity analysis on the parsed page data.

## Content structure agents

Runs the lower Claude agent cluster for internal linking, content quality, and site architecture analysis.

## Synthesize page diagnosis

Combines all specialist agent responses and creates a consolidated SEO diagnosis for the current page, then loops back to process the next URL.

## Return final report

Builds the completed crawl-level SEO report and sends it back through the webhook response path.

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are a technical SEO auditor. Assess the crawlability and technical health of this page: its HTTP status code, whether its canonical tag looks correct and self-referential (or points elsewhere for a good reason), its robots meta directives, and any obvious technical red flags. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
Status code: ' + $json.statusCode + '
Canonical: ' + $json.canonical + '
Robots meta: ' + $json.metaRobots + '
Has JSON-LD structured data: ' + $json.hasJsonLd + '
Internal links found: ' + $json.internalLinkCount + '
External links found: ' + $json.externalLinkCount } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are a search-intent SEO analyst. Judge whether this page's title, headings, and apparent topic coherently match the search intent someone would have for that topic (informational, transactional, navigational, or commercial-investigation) - and whether the page actually satisfies that intent rather than just mentioning the keyword. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Meta description: ' + $json.metaDescription + '
H1s: ' + JSON.stringify($json.h1s) + '
H2s: ' + JSON.stringify($json.h2s) + '
Word count: ' + $json.wordCount } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are an entity and topical-SEO analyst. Assess whether this page clearly establishes a single primary entity or topic through its title, H1, and headings, whether structured data reinforces that entity, and whether the page covers the related sub-topics a genuinely authoritative page on this subject would be expected to cover. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
Title: ' + $json.title + '
H1s: ' + JSON.stringify($json.h1s) + '
H2s: ' + JSON.stringify($json.h2s) + '
Has JSON-LD structured data: ' + $json.hasJsonLd + '
Word count: ' + $json.wordCount } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are an internal linking strategist. Assess this page's internal linking health: whether its internal link count suggests it is well-integrated into the site or at risk of being an orphan/link-starved page, and whether the depth at which it was found (clicks from the homepage) is reasonable for its apparent importance. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
Crawl depth: ' + $json.currentDepth + '
Internal links found on page: ' + $json.internalLinkCount + '
External links found on page: ' + $json.externalLinkCount + '
Title: ' + $json.title } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are a content quality auditor. Assess whether this page's word count is sufficient given the configured thin-content threshold, whether its heading structure (H1/H2 pattern) suggests organized, substantive content versus a thin or boilerplate page, and whether images missing alt text suggest neglected content maintenance. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
Word count: ' + $json.wordCount + '
Thin content threshold: ' + $json.thinContentWordThreshold + '
H1 count: ' + $json.h1Count + '
H2 count: ' + ($json.h2s ? $json.h2s.length : 0) + '
Images total: ' + $json.imagesTotal + '
Images missing alt text: ' + $json.imagesMissingAlt } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 700, system: 'You are a site architecture analyst. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no prose, matching exactly this shape: {"score": number (0-100), "issues": [{"severity": "high"|"medium"|"low", "issue": string, "recommendation": string}], "summary": string}.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'URL: ' + $json.currentUrl + '
